'''Glimmer''' is a mare from the [[Royal Palace of Andor|Royal Palace]] of [[Andor]].

==Appearance==
Glimmer is a mare of [[Saldaea]]n stock, with a fine white mane and coat. She is very fast.

==Activities==
Glimmer carries [[Elayne Trakand]] to her coronation in [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|13|52}}
